identity_locks.camera: Preserve V2 elevated game-sprite perspective and locked framing.
identity_locks.costume: Mustard-gold short cape/scarf, dark olive/navy underlayers, bronze/gold armor, split ivory tunic, teal waist detail, tall dark boots, leather belts and gloves.
identity_locks.face: Youthful male storybook warrior; keep eyes mostly concealed beneath swept bangs.
identity_locks.hair: Short tousled silver/lavender-grey hair with broad swept fringe; no redesign.
identity_locks.style: Softly painted stylized 2D volumes and warm restrained shading; no hard black outline, plastic sheen, photorealism, or Ragnarok sprite copying.
identity_locks.weapon: Straight narrow one-handed steel sword with warm bronze/gold hilt in anatomical right hand.
